# Technology Stack

## Build System

This project uses **Projen** for project configuration and build management. All configuration is defined in `.projenrc.ts`.

**Important**: Do not manually edit generated files (marked with `~~ Generated by projen` comment). Instead, modify `.projenrc.ts` and run `pnpm exec projen` to regenerate.

## Core Technologies

- **AWS CDK** v2.166.0 - Infrastructure as Code
- **TypeScript** - Primary language, ES modules
- **Node.js** - Runtime environment, version pinned in `mise.toml`
- **Docker** - Container image for Fargate service

## AWS Services

- Amazon API Gateway HTTP API
- AWS Fargate (ECS)
- Amazon VPC with isolated subnets
- VPC Endpoints (Interface & Gateway)
- AWS Cloud Map (Service Discovery)
- Amazon ECR (container registry)

## Development Tools

- Biome - Linting and formatting
- Vitest - Tests in `test/`
- pnpm - Package manager
- esbuild - Bundling
- tsx - TypeScript execution

## Common Commands

```bash
# Build the project
pnpm exec projen build

# Synthesize CloudFormation template
pnpm exec projen synth

# Deploy to AWS
pnpm exec projen deploy

# Destroy stack
pnpm exec projen destroy

# Show diff against deployed stack
pnpm exec projen diff

# Run linter
pnpm exec projen biome

# Watch mode for development
pnpm exec projen watch

# Upgrade dependencies
pnpm exec projen upgrade
```

## CDK Configuration

- Entry point: `src/main.ts`
- CDK app command: `npx tsx src/main.ts`
- Output directory: `cdk.out`
- New style stack synthesis enabled
